newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re to reveal details on shareholdings.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re to reveal details on shareholdings.

text.p: Reinsurer Muenchener Rueckversicherungs-Gesellschaft AG, or Munich Re, said it would release details of its shareholdings with market value of more than 100 million marks in response to a court order.

The Bavarian Supreme Court ordered the reinsurer to reveal the information following a complaint from one of its shareholders, Ekkehard Wenger, a professor at Wuerzburg University, a Munich Re spokesman said on Monday.
Munich Re would obey the order, the second it has received since Wenger started his campaign in 1993, the spokesman said.
The order is effective retrospectively from June 30 1993.
Munich Re had until now refused to comply, complaining that 100 million marks represented only a fraction of its capital investments of more than 100 billion marks.
